description: Money is converted to cents by truncating a floating point product, so some prices lose a cent.
prompt: The tests in src/money.test.ts are failing. Find and fix the bug in this repository so that every test passes. Do not change the tests.

mustPass: an amount is converted to the nearest cent
awkward amounts land on the nearest cent
an amount already on a cent boundary is not pushed up
a refund rounds the same way a charge does

notes: toCents truncates amount * 100 instead of rounding it. Binary floating point puts 1.15 * 100 at 114.99999999999999, so truncation drops a cent on the amounts that land just under. The fix is Math.round. The withheld tests cover amounts that are already exact and a refund, so hard-coding the one visible amount, adding an epsilon before truncating, or switching to Math.ceil all fail: ceil turns 1.1 into 111 cents and 0.07 into 8.
